title: Shadow of the Beast PNA crack: caller-owned TRAP #0 and native Supervisor entry
status: PASS for bounded intro, disk changes and opening gameplay
scope: Bounded compatibility replay, not complete game, audio quality, unsupported-API or performance acceptance. No emulator timing, pinned CPU or host OS shim changes.

failure.request: DoIO command 2, $4D600 bytes, destination $1BDE0, disk offset $2C00
failure.observed: The native BeginIO supervisor wrapper enters the caller trap, leaves io_Actual at the preceding $1A00, and does not populate the stage. The game jumps to zeroed $67F00.
failure.fix: Use the privilege-violation vector and privileged SR gate; construct the RTE frame for supervisor callers; chain unrelated exceptions; preserve caller software traps. No additional public IORequest checks.

rom.scope: 68000 PAL OCS A500; native DF0; custom boot blocks, DOS0/DOS1 startup, native CON and interactive boot CLI; optional 512 KiB slow RAM bounce test

readerRom.scope: PAL OCS A500, 68000, 512 KiB Chip RAM, polled DF0 sector reads; no boot-block execution

sourceProvenance.note: Only the Exec managed producer changes relative to the preceding qualified frozen input set. The remaining frozen producers retain that record's concurrent-source provenance. This is an observed binary/source overlay, not reproduction from one clean source commit.

precedingProvenance.note: Shared-checkout producer identities, not a clean-commit reproduction claim. The original C# producer snapshot includes concurrent console/DOS edits excluded from the graphics commits. The final rebuild substitutes Exec producer 79D210... and the final standalone native emitter; all other managed C# producers remain frozen.

overlap: Native ROM and regression suites overlap; component 83 plus the independent new privilege-chain case are distinct. Do not sum all suite totals.
